From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde heavy armor. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system and specialized flex-point joints.  

The Daimyo edition is colored brown and gray with polished steel plating.
